UpdateStageDescription: Writing AMP-managed ports and API key to infrarust.toml
UpdateSourceData:
bind = "0.0.0.0:{{$GamePort}}"
servers_dir = "./servers"
plugins_dir = "./plugins"

[web]
bind = "0.0.0.0:{{$WebPort}}"
api_key = "{{WebApiKey}}"

[forwarding]
mode = "velocity"
secret_file = "./forwarding.secret"
